properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 15 at 1:26PM MDT until August 15 at 2:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
SVRBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Jefferson County in central Colorado...
Western Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
Southwestern Denver County in northeastern Colorado...
North Central Douglas County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 200 PM MDT.

* At 126 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Tiny Town, or
16 miles southwest of Denver, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Western Denver, Lakewood, southwestern Centennial, Highlands Ranch,
Littleton, Englewood, southeastern Wheat Ridge, southern Golden,
Greenwood Village, Evergreen, Sheridan, Morrison, Chatfield
Reservoir, Red Rocks Park, Tiny Town, Idledale, Indian Hills,
Kittredge and Cherry Hills Village.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 15 at 1:26PM MDT until August 15 at 3:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...East Central Jefferson County in central Colorado...
Southwestern Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
Extreme Southwestern Denver County in northeastern Colorado...
Northwestern Douglas County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 330 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 125 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This may cause urban
and small stream flooding. Up to 0.5 inches of rain have fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Southern Lakewood, southwestern Centennial, Highlands Ranch,
Littleton, southern Englewood, Greenwood Village, Sheridan,
Morrison, Chatfield Reservoir, Red Rocks Park, Cherry Hills
Village, Columbine and Ken Caryl.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 15 at 12:09PM MDT until August 15 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding along Bijou Creek caused by excessive rainfall.

* WHERE...Rural and low lying areas along Bijou Creek in northern
Elbert, Central Adams, Central Arapahoe, and southwestern Morgan
Counties.

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding along Bijou Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 1204 PM MDT, Local law enforcement reported flooding had
occurred along Bijou Creek through Adams County. Water had caused
closer of a couple county roads, but they have since reopened.
Water had also crested and spilled onto Colfax Avenue in rural
Adams County. The crest has passed this area, but will continue
moving downstream and affect areas farther north through the Hoyt
area and toward the confluence with the South Platte River in
Morgan County.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
West Bijou Creek and Bijou Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
rural and low lying areas along Bijou Creek.
